view_definition:
WITH data_spm_default AS (
         SELECT toll_sections.id AS section_id,
            m_spm.id AS spm_id,
            m_spm.service_substance_id,
            m_spm.code,
            m_spm.indicator,
            m_spm.sub_indicator,
            m_spm.description,
            m_spm.is_static,
            m_spm.spm_specification,
            m_spm.operator,
            m_spm.spm_parameter,
            m_spm.unit,
            m_spm.score_default
           FROM toll_sections
             CROSS JOIN m_spm
          WHERE m_spm.active = true
          ORDER BY toll_sections.id, m_spm.service_substance_id, m_spm.id
        )
 SELECT a.section_id,
    a.spm_id,
    a.service_substance_id,
    a.code,
    a.indicator,
    a.sub_indicator,
    a.description,
    a.is_static,
    a.spm_specification,
        CASE
            WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.sla_specification
            ELSE a.spm_specification
        END AS sla_specification,
    a.operator,
    a.spm_parameter,
        CASE
            WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.sla_parameter
            ELSE a.spm_parameter
        END AS sla_parameter,
    a.unit,
        CASE
            WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.is_applicable
            ELSE true
        END AS is_applicable,
    a.score_default
   FROM data_spm_default a
     LEFT JOIN m_sla b ON b.spm_id = a.spm_id AND b.section_id = a.section_id
  ORDER BY a.section_id, a.service_substance_id, a.spm_id;
